product_metadata.title: Rod Desyne Oval Spring Tension Rod 36"-60", Black, 36-60"
features: Adjustable from 36 - 60. The spring is stiff, only extend the rod 1/4" beyond the width of the frame and compress it 1/4" and slide the rod into place.
Solid steel construction with heavy duty steel spring
Firm gripping plastic ends hold rod securely in place without damaging mounting surface
Easy to install. Screwdriver needed. Adjust the spring and screw assembly to 1 inch longer than the ideal size for spring compression.
Rod Dimensions: Height 11/16 inch Depth 7/16 inch
description: Perfect for small door and window rod pocket drapery applications, this lightweight oval tension rod securely holds panels in place without scuffing mounting surfaces. The rod features an adjustable two piece design with one tightening screw and spring.
